title: Features: Dependencies and Features That Enable Others | Orchard Core
description:
Some Orchard Core features need other features to work, so enabling or disabling one can change several others.

The Features page shows the dependencies of each feature, enables the dependencies of a feature you enable, and lists the dependent features before it disables them. A few features have no working switch: some are enabled only while another feature needs them, and others are always enabled.

In this video:
• Features need features: dependencies and dependents
• Dependencies on the Features page: badges, tooltips and indirect dependencies
• Enable a feature: its dependencies are enabled with it
• Disable a feature: its dependents are disabled with it
• Features you do not switch by hand: on demand and always enabled
